title.en: The End of the Beginning and the Beginning of the End

comments.text: It started!
There's a setting that Subaru's wallet is the kind that goes "rriiip-rriiip" when opened (lol).
The people of the royal capital move around a whole lot.
This is where the light returns to Subaru's eyes. I'm glad they paid attention to that.
I flinch every time the commercials end.
Hah!!
A tiny little detail with barely any registrations!
Felt is cute no matter when or what scene you see her in.
Here she is! Our heroine!
Ton! Chin! Kan!
A part over!
This is the problem scene lol
The sensuousness of Puck's lower body is wonderfully done.
We could have just made it normally plump, but everyone unanimously agreed on its current shape.
We're back.
Saturday Night Fever
Puck is so calculating—just as expected of Puck, so calculating.
I ended up using this explanation a lot: "Shinimodori" has the same intonation as "hikikomori."
I want to protect this smile.
Suddenly, the cutest little girl.
The art of winning over little girls that I mastered while shut in…!
The heroine is cute, but the backgrounds are incredible too, so please watch those. And pay attention to the voices. And the content. And the movement. And the little details.
You don't hear that much these days!

This is setting material that ties into the main story just a little, but if you pay attention to the hair color of the fruit seller's wife, you'll realize she has a connection to that character whose colors appear in the books. Really. Just a little.
How's that!
Puck's chest fur looks so fluffy, I want to touch it.
I was torn over whether to have someone chime in with, "Impressive?" here.
B part over!!
From here on, just enjoy it all in one go. Now then, C part begins!
The direction in this dark place is very beautiful.
Gah! That hurts!
His abs are surprisingly impressive.
The tactical sense to target the guy with the knife first.
The one who loses to a dog's bark going "Woof!"
The many stolen goods placed inside the loot house were also supervised and researched properly. The detail is amazing. I was impressed.
This is how people who are bad at opening bags do it!
C part over!
D part begins!!
The back-and-forth between Old Man Rom and Felt is really cute.
Please notice how every little movement Felt makes is cute. Also please notice how every little movement Subaru makes is so noisy.
In this one photo, the way Felt's eyes are shining is such a finely crafted touch.
Subaru's cellphone was also supervised, and they used a truly, incredibly outdated flip phone as reference.
A grandpa who's happy to be relied on by his grandkid.
Oh wow, this dark-skinned lady is cute.
"That means you'd be unemployed!"
The design on this coin was also properly supervised, and the image depicted on the holy gold coin is the Divine Dragon.
From here on, please don't take your eyes off the screen.
Elsa-san is bad at handling knives.
The way Elsa-san's strength is portrayed is wonderful.
Ah, he died.

Actually, in the ending staff credits, I slipped in a small message from the author to everyone who's been with us. The idea originally came from Kugane Maruyama-san, but I thought it would be nice if it became a standard thing for anime adaptations from Shosetsuka ni Naro.
Re:Zero, good work on the one-hour anime! Thank you for watching along! Sorry for being such a noisy author! But this is fun! I'm happy! I can't stop!
Well then, thank you for staying with me so late. It'll be next week again, and the author will probably be noisy every week. It's a long story, but I'd be happy if you stayed with me.
Well then, good night! Thank you for today!
